prompt:
A 45-year-old with type 1 diabetes and overt diabetic nephropathy (proteinuria >500 mg/day, serum creatinine ≤2.5 mg/dL) asks about starting an ACE inhibitor.

Based on the CSG Captopril Trial, quantify the magnitude of renal function preservation: event counts and risk reduction for doubling of serum creatinine, and how creatinine clearance decline compared overall and in patients with baseline creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL.

rubric_items.text: Reports doubling of serum creatinine in 25/207 captopril-treated patients versus 43/202 placebo-treated patients, with the trial-reported 48% risk reduction and P = 0.007.
States materially incorrect trial event counts, reverses the direction of the treatment effect, or attributes a material finding to the trial that its results do not support.

Reports annual creatinine-clearance decline of 11% with captopril versus 17% with placebo overall (P = 0.03), and 23% versus 37%, respectively, among patients with baseline serum creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL (P = 0.01).
